item.title: Mahindra Blues Festival 2026 Unites Global Blues Icons at Mehboob Studios
item.description: The 14th Mahindra Blues Festival turned Mehboob Studios into a two-day celebration of global blues, featuring Matt Schofield, Shemekia Copeland, Eric Gales and a collaborative All-Star Jam finale.

item.title: Former Spotify India Editorial Head Aoneha Tagore Launches Artist Management Firm Collabor8
item.description: Former Spotify India Head of Editorial Aoneha Tagore has launched Collabor8 Agency, a new artist management and brand advisory firm focused on long-term career development.

item.title: Aura Event & Experiences Executes PayPal’s Annual Employee Gathering Across Chennai and Bengaluru
item.description: Aura Event & Experiences executed PayPal’s Annual Employee Gathering across Chennai and Bengaluru, bringing together over 4,000 employees in a large-scale cultural celebration.

item.title: Shobiz Experiential Delivers Transformation NOW! 2026 India in Hyderabad with 1,500+ Industry Leaders
item.description: Shobiz Experiential delivered Transformation NOW! 2026 India in Hyderabad, convening over 1,500 industry leaders and unveiling key enterprise partnerships and technology initiatives.

item.title: Prime Minister Narendra Modi Inaugurates India AI Impact Expo 2026 Ahead of Global AI Summit
item.description: Prime Minister Narendra Modi inaugurated the India AI Impact Expo 2026 at Bharat Mandapam, opening a five day showcase ahead of the global India AI Impact Summit focused on responsible and inclusive AI development.

item.title: Tribes Communication Marks 11th Edition of ROAR, Enters New Phase as Fully Independent Agency
item.description: Tribes Communication marked the 11th edition of ROAR in New Delhi, signalling its transition into a fully independent agency with a consulting-led, technology-enabled growth strategy.

item.title: Pavilions and Interiors India Private Limited Named Expo & Event Management Partner for India AI Impact Summit 2026
item.description: Pavilions and Interiors India Private Limited has been named Expo & Event Management Partner for the India AI Impact Summit 2026 in New Delhi, bringing over five decades of exhibition expertise to the event.

item.title: WOW Awards Asia 2026 Is Back for Its 17th Edition to Reunite Events & Experiential Industry Leaders in Mumbai
item.description: WOW Awards Asia 2026 returns to Mumbai for its 17th edition, bringing together leaders from experiential marketing, MICE, weddings and live entertainment.

item.title: Oberoi Mall to Host Fourth Edition of ‘The Pooch Party’ on February 22
item.description: Oberoi Mall will host the fourth edition of “The Pooch Party” on February 22, featuring games, a fashion walk, retail kiosks and an adoption drive for dogs.

item.title: South Asia Travel and Tourism Exchange to Bring Global Travel Trade to New Delhi from February 25–27
item.description: SATTE 2026 will take place at Yashobhoomi, New Delhi, from February 25–27, bringing together global travel stakeholders, with Goa Tourism among participating destinations.
